context.content_translation:
所有海报和传单必须在活动结束后 48 小时内从公告板上移除。
A. 在……内
B. 在……中
C. 除非
D. 当……时候

items.question: All posters and flyers must be removed from the bulletin board ------- 48 hours after the event has occurred.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“within”代入题干后为“All posters and flyers must be removed from the bulletin board within 48 hours after the event has occurred.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：A（within）。
